name: calendar-manager
description: Eight agents run Paul's calendar SOP from a Claude scheduled task: conflicts, commute and travel blocks, colors, notes, 1:1s, plus Gmail checks that hold every time he offers by email and flag invites missing from his calendar. When unsure they ask in the task's chat, and each answer becomes a rule. A hook blocks deletes, invites (Callie on travel excepted), RSVPs and messages during runs.
